VioletPokecenterElmsAideFavorText:
, long
time, no see.

PROF.ELM asked me
to find you.

He has another
favor to ask.

Would you take the
#MON EGG?
VioletPokecenterElmsAideGiveEggText:
We discovered that
a #MON will not

hatch until it
grows in the EGG.

It also has to be
with other active #MON to hatch.

, you're
the only person we can rely on.

Please call PROF.
ELM when that EGG hatches!
VioletCityElmsAideFullPartyText:
Oh, no. You can't
carry any more #MON with you.

I'll wait here
while you make room for the EGG.
VioletPokecenterFarawayLinkText:
I've been thinking
it'd be great to

be able to link up
and battle with my

friends who live
far away.
VioletPokecenterMobileAdapterText:
I just battled a
friend in CIANWOOD over a link.

If you connect a
MOBILE ADAPTER,

you can link with
a friend far away.
VioletPokecenter1FGameboyKidText:
A guy named BILL
made the #MON PC storage system.
VioletPokecenter1FGentlemanText:
It was around
three years ago.

TEAM ROCKET was up
to no good with #MON.

But justice pre-
vailed--a young kid broke 'em up.
VioletPokecenter1FYoungsterText:
#MON are smart.
They won't obey a

trainer they don't
respect.

Without the right
GYM BADGES, they

will just do as
they please.
